title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
abstract_first: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses.
